sections.title: Summary
sections.content:
**No tests exist.** The project has five testable Node.js modules in `.claude/helpers/`:

| File | Exported Functions | Tests |
|------|-------------------|-------|
| `router.js` | `routeTask`, `AGENT_CAPABILITIES`, `TASK_PATTERNS` | None |
| `memory.js` | `get`, `set`, `delete`, `clear`, `keys` | None |
| `session.js` | `start`, `restore`, `end`, `status`, `update`, `get`, `metric` | None |
| `intelligence.cjs` | `tokenize`, `trigrams`, `jaccardSimilarity`, `deduplicateById`, `fingerprintContent`, `deduplicateByContent`, `computePageRank`, `buildEdges`, `init`, `getContext`, `recordEdit`, `feedback`, `consolidate`, `stats` | None |
| `hook-handler.cjs` | `safeRequire`, `runWithTimeout`, `readStdin`, all hook handlers | None |

---

sections.title: Gap 1: `router.js` — Pattern matching logic
Gap 2: `memory.js` — Silent error swallowing, missing-key paths
Gap 3: `session.js` — File-missing branches, metric edge cases
Gap 4: `intelligence.cjs` — Pure functions are fully untested
Gap 5: `hook-handler.cjs` — Dangerous command detection, timeout protection
Gap 6: Integration Tests (full lifecycle)
Setup Required
sections.content:
Since no `package.json` exists, add Jest to run these tests:

```bash

sections.title: In project root
sections.content:
npm init -y
npm install --save-dev jest
```

Add to `package.json`:
```json
{
  "scripts": { "test": "jest" },
  "jest": {
    "testEnvironment": "node",
    "testMatch": ["**/tests/**/*.test.js"]
  }
}
```

Tests go in `/tests/` per the project rules (not in root).

---

sections.title: Priority Order
sections.content:
| Priority | File | Reason |
|----------|------|--------|
| 1 | `intelligence.cjs` pure functions | Complex algorithms, subtle bugs (FNV-1a hashing, Jaccard, PageRank convergence) |
| 2 | `hook-handler.cjs: pre-bash` | Security-critical — dangerous command blocking must be correct |
| 3 | `memory.js` | All data persistence flows through here; silent error swallowing hides corruption |
| 4 | `session.js` | Session metric tracking and archive logic has multiple file-operation branches |
| 5 | `router.js` | Simple but the first-match-wins ordering is an unverified contract |
| 6 | Integration tests | Validates the full hook pipeline that Claude Code depends on |
